snippet.title: The Man from the Window - Trailer
snippet.description:
Another free, short, indie horror game from Zed_Technician :)

Get it here: https://zed-technician.itch.io/the-man-from-the-window
I've made other things: https://zed-technician.itch.io/

"Mama Rabbit returns home from work one late night.

Awake long past his bedtime, a very frightened Junior Rabbit rushes in.

The book in his hands has very visibly spooked him, and Mama Rabbit tries convincing him that it's only a story.

But then a tap-tap-tapping begins on the window..."
